_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Work Specification Report
summary: The Work Specification Report is used by the government to verify that NAVSEA Standard Items and Standard Work Items were adhered to and on schedule per task milestones and completion dates.
use_relationship:
This data will be used by the government to verify that NAVSEA Standard Items (SI) and Standard Work Items (SWI) were adhered and is on schedule relating in accordance to the task milestones and/or completion dates.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
Reference cited in DID can obtained from Department of the Navy, SUBMEPP, PO BOX 2500, Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Portsmouth, NH 03804-2500.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of documents cited herein, including approval dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revision shall be as cited in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all of the information specified in Joint Fleet Forces Maintenance Manual Volume 7, Chapter 4 (Appendix 4-E).

preparation_instructions.title: The report shall also contain a title page
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall also contain a title page specifying the following:

children.title: Preparing activity or contractor's title and telephone number
